concerns.text: The specification does not define any user stories (US‑xxx). The mandatory ‘User Stories & Testing’ block is empty, leaving the project without any anchored goals for the functional requirements or success criteria.

FR‑001 (Baseline Analysis) – and all subsequent FR‑002 through FR‑006 – are not anchored to any user story; no reference such as ‘See US‑1’ or an implied story scope is present, making these functional requirements orphaned.

SC‑001, SC‑002, and SC‑03 are not linked to any user story; they are orphaned success criteria. Additionally, the identifier ‘SC‑03’ appears to be a typo (should likely be SC‑003), which further breaks traceability.
